title: Redefining the Narrative: New Archives Discovered in Goa
author: Cornelia Team
excerpt: Researchers have unearthed a significant collection of letters and manuscripts dating back to the 18th century, offering unprecedented insights into the social standing and property rights of women in coastal communities during the transition to colonial rule.
content:
The discovery of historical archives provides new perspectives on women's agency.

Colonial records often obscured women's roles in society.

These newly discovered documents challenge traditional historical narratives.
